mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 5% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for two consecutive months and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by more than 1% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 300,000 and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real final sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If both HOUST and RSAFS increase and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and CPI (CPIAUCSL) YoY growth is below 3%, the monetary policy is considered tight but inflation is under control, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with controlled inflation
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 3% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.
